cohort: The study included 100 preterm neonates who received surfactant, defined as being less than 34 weeks gestational age and weighing less than 1750g.
finding: Prophylactic surfactant therapy significantly reduced the incidence (18.2% vs 50.0%) and severity (4.5% vs 32.1% requiring intervention) of Retinopathy of Prematurity compared to therapeutic surfactant therapy in preterm neonates.
